name: B.I.R.D.S.
summary: The year is 2392, almost one year after the first aliens arrived on earth. The curiosity the birds once showed towards the aliens and their exotic technology has long since faded, it has now been replaced with dread. No one knows what the real intention of these aliens is. But it's now clear that if noting is done, the future of earth and for it's native inhabitants will be very dark.
